protocol: Single rapid chamber test per volunteer. Initial cabin altitude 8,000 ft, variable measured peaks and mask timing. The authors report absence of denitrogenation.
outcome_window: The authors obtained a subject report the following morning and stopped monitoring if there were no adverse reactions. Exact elapsed follow-up is unavailable.
locator: Methods pp. 426–427; Table I p. 427; Discussion and Summary p. 430 (PDF p. 6)
note: The historical symptom endpoint is preserved as printed. The study gives no separately adjudicated DCS outcome or instrumented VGE tally.

protocol: Repeated one-minute chamber plateaus from 39,000 to 45,000 ft with returns to 35,000 ft between climbs. Twenty minutes of ground denitrogenation before the equipment test sequence.
outcome_window: During the described protocol. Post-exposure follow-up is unspecified.
locator: Subjects and Experimental Protocol p. 691 (PDF p. 2)
note: The symptom statement is explicit. An exact outcome denominator is unavailable. The dysbaric disturbance that prevented one volunteer from completing the tests has no reported diagnostic adjudication.
